items.title: Enrich renderEvidenceStaleHint with a done_prepare one-step line + a drift-classification line
items.context: packages/main/src/core/evidence-stale-hint.ts renderEvidenceStaleHint: keep the existing stable lines (the EVIDENCE STALE marker + Meaning + `lattice verification_evidence_refresh_stale --storyId=...` + `lattice validate --story=... --json`). ADD (a) a drift-classification line: whole-tree materialHash drift with UNCHANGED story-owned files (storyFilesHash) is usually unrelated/main drift -> refresh, do not re-review; storyFilesHash change = story-owned drift -> re-review/re-quorum; and (b) a one-step recovery line: `lattice done_prepare --storyId=... --mergeMain --refreshStale --validate` for TEST->DONE convergence. The three consuming surfaces (handlers/hints.ts, handlers/session.ts, handlers/transition-orchestrator.ts) call the shared renderer and auto-inherit; do not edit them unless they reconstruct the string. Keep storyId-substitution (no literal <storyId> placeholders, per B-a2f1 preMortem #3).

happy.desc: renderEvidenceStaleHint(storyId, stale, {currentHead}) output contains a line with `lattice done_prepare --storyId=<storyId>` (with real storyId substituted, no placeholders); WHY: confirms the one-step recovery line is present in the canonical block

renderEvidenceStaleHint(storyId, stale, {currentHead}) output contains a drift-classification line distinguishing materialHash-only drift (storyFilesHash unchanged -> refresh, do not re-review) from storyFilesHash drift (story-owned -> re-review/re-quorum); WHY: confirms the drift-class token is rendered

The three consuming surfaces (hints.ts decorateResult / session.ts session_brief / transition-orchestrator.ts story_advance) produce byte-identical output to the renderer for both the done_prepare and drift-class lines (the existing cross-surface byte-equality contract from B-a2f1 still holds after the enrichment); WHY: preMortem #2 three-way identity

edge.desc: renderEvidenceStaleHint with empty storyId returns empty string (no done_prepare or drift-class lines leak); WHY: anti-placeholder guard still works with more lines
renderEvidenceStaleHint with stale=[] returns empty string even when storyId is valid; WHY: no-stale guard prevents spurious recovery block

The existing stable lines (EVIDENCE_STALE_MARKER / Meaning / refresh_stale command / validate command) are preserved verbatim in the output after enrichment; WHY: backward-compat — existing surfaces must not break
storyId containing special characters (e.g. B-bdce) is substituted literally into the done_prepare command, not escaped or mangled; WHY: the done_prepare command must be copy-pasteable

adversarial.desc: If a surface (hints.ts / session.ts / transition-orchestrator.ts) were to reconstruct the done_prepare or drift-class line instead of calling renderEvidenceStaleHint, the byte-equality smoke would catch the divergence and fail; WHY: the shared-renderer contract is enforced by the smoke, not just by convention
The drift-classification line does not contain literal placeholder tokens like <storyId> or <B-xxx>; WHY: preMortem #3 anti-placeholder anchor extended to the new line

items.userSees: In a stale-evidence situation the EVIDENCE STALE block (session_brief / `lattice validate` / story_advance pre-check) now also shows a drift-classification line and a `lattice done_prepare --storyId=<id> --mergeMain --refreshStale --validate` one-step line, in addition to the existing refresh_stale + validate lines.

verificationEvidence.note: smoke asserts renderedBlock.includes(`lattice done_prepare --storyId=${storyId} --mergeMain --refreshStale --validate`) (GAP1) — done_prepare one-step line present.
smoke asserts the drift-class line (GAP2 token regex + includes('Drift class:')) — drift-classification line present.
smoke asserts briefBlock===renderedBlock (session_brief) and validateBlock===renderedBlock (validate hint) — the 3 surfaces auto-inherit byte-identically.
smoke asserts renderEvidenceStaleHint('', stale) === '' — empty storyId leaks nothing.
smoke asserts freshHint (stale=[]) === '' — no-stale guard returns empty.
smoke asserts the existing stable lines remain: EVIDENCE_STALE_MARKER, 'HEAD/material hash binding changed', refresh_stale command, validate command — backward-compat preserved.
storyId is interpolated literally via template literal `--storyId=${storyId}` (no escaping); the smoke asserts includes(`--storyId=${storyId}`) with the real storyId.

All 3 surfaces call the shared renderEvidenceStaleHint (no local reconstruction); the smoke's briefBlock===renderedBlock / validateBlock===renderedBlock byte-equality asserts would FAIL if any surface reconstructed/diverged.
smoke asserts !renderedBlock.includes('<storyId>') and !includes('<B-') — no literal placeholder tokens (B-a2f1 preMortem #3).

items.title: Update the byte-equality smokes + add the regression assertions
items.context: Update the rendered-hint byte-output assertions in packages/main/src/tasks/verification-freshness-smoke.ts ONLY (it imports renderEvidenceStaleHint at line 13 and asserts the block at ~487-565, incl. the extractStaleBlock helper at ~593 that hardcodes a fixed line-count slice — grow it for the added drift-class + done_prepare lines). Add the red/spike regression assertions: the rendered hint contains `done_prepare` AND a drift-classification token (storyFilesHash/story-owned/whole-tree/unrelated) so dropping either line FAILs. NOTE: tasks/flow-stability-smoke.ts only uses findStaleEvidence (unchanged) and is OUT OF SCOPE — do not edit it. Run verification-freshness-smoke green.

happy.desc: npm run smoke:freshness (verification-freshness-smoke.ts) passes green after the extractStaleBlock line-count slice is grown to accommodate the new done_prepare + drift-class lines; WHY: confirms the byte-equality assertions match the enriched renderer output

The smoke asserts that the rendered hint contains the substring `done_prepare` (regression anchor for CHK-001 done_prepare line); WHY: red/spike regression — dropping the done_prepare line from the renderer makes the smoke FAIL

The smoke asserts that the rendered hint contains a drift-classification token (one of: storyFilesHash / story-owned / whole-tree / unrelated); WHY: red/spike regression — dropping the drift-class line from the renderer makes the smoke FAIL

edge.desc: extractStaleBlock in the smoke correctly extracts the full enriched block (marker + meaning + run-to-recover + refresh_stale + validate + done_prepare + drift-class) with the updated line count; the extracted block still equals renderEvidenceStaleHint output byte-for-byte; WHY: the extraction helper must grow with the renderer
flow-stability-smoke.ts is NOT edited and still passes (it only uses findStaleEvidence, not renderEvidenceStaleHint); WHY: out-of-scope guard — this story must not break the flow-stability smoke

adversarial.desc: If the done_prepare line is removed from renderEvidenceStaleHint but the smoke is NOT updated, the smoke fails (the new assertion catches the missing line); WHY: the regression assertion is a true red test — it detects removal of the done_prepare line

If the drift-classification line is removed from renderEvidenceStaleHint but the smoke is NOT updated, the smoke fails (the new assertion catches the missing drift token); WHY: the regression assertion is a true red test — it detects removal of the drift-class line

The byte-equality assertions across the 3 surfaces (session_brief / story_advance / validate hint) continue to hold after the smoke update — if a surface drifts from the renderer the smoke catches it; WHY: preMortem #2 cross-surface byte-identity is still enforced after adding new lines

items.userSees: `node packages/main/dist/tasks/verification-freshness-smoke.js` prints its pass line with the updated byte-equality assertions; the GAP1 (done_prepare) and GAP2 (drift-class token) regression assertions are present.

verificationEvidence.note: verification-freshness-smoke passes green after extractStaleBlock was updated from a 5-line to an 8-line slice.
the smoke contains the GAP1 regression anchor: assert.ok(renderedBlock.includes(`lattice done_prepare ...`)).
the smoke contains the GAP2 regression anchor: assert.ok(/storyFilesHash|story-owned|whole-tree|unrelated/.test(renderedBlock)) + includes('Drift class:').
extractStaleBlock now slices markerIdx+8 and the briefBlock/validateBlock byte-equality asserts pass — the full enriched block is extracted.
flow-stability-smoke is unedited (git diff shows only evidence-stale-hint.ts + verification-freshness-smoke.ts) and still passes — it only uses findStaleEvidence, not the renderer.

Proven by the red/spike: the RED test (exit 1, before the fix) failed precisely because the done_prepare line was absent; the GAP1 assert directly checks that substring, so removing the line from the renderer makes the assert false and the smoke fail.
Proven by the red/spike: the RED test failed because the drift-class line was absent; the GAP2/'Drift class:' asserts directly check it, so removing the line makes the smoke fail.
the smoke's cross-surface byte-equality asserts (briefBlock===renderedBlock, validateBlock===renderedBlock) continue to hold with the enriched 8-line block.
